_comment: VIEW rendered by crosslinks.py render. Authority is each folder's links.json.

domains.title: Geo-seismic: USGS quakes on the globe, IRIS seismo-acoustics in the bridge
domains.shape: Point-process transducer (USGS) -> band claim -> residual router. The globe shows every event; nothing tests a rate.

avenues.title: USGS feed as a transducer for the field claim loop
Aftershock structure as the NOISE_AS_SIGNAL positive control
Depth bands are a 2-bit non-Gray code

domains.title: Atmosphere and storm: Open-Meteo + FIRMS on the globe, NDBC buoys + HURDAT2 in the bridge
domains.shape: Two live thermal/fluid feeds on the globe (weather, fires) and one live thermal/fluid feed in the bridge (buoys) that has never been drawn.

avenues.title: NDBC buoys as a GEV data layer
NHC active storms as annotation polygons
FIRMS confidence <-> epistemology grade
Buoy pressure/wind residuals through the claim loop during a named storm

domains.title: Orbital: CelesTrak TLEs and SGP4 on the globe, gravity encoder and precession in the bridge
domains.shape: TLE -> SGP4 -> position is a forecast whose error grows with epoch age. GEV draws it; the bridge has the potential-energy encoder and a drift detector but no orbit.

avenues.title: SGP4 state -> gravity encoder payload
TLE epoch age as a drift claim
precession.py vs celestialRing.js cross-check
ISS pass windows as orbital-phycom link opportunities

domains.title: Mobility: ADS-B flights, AIS vessels, road traffic on the globe; interval propagation and residual routing in the bridge
domains.shape: A dead-reckoning coast between polls is a point forecast. The bridge's Kimchi engine widens an interval instead and flags when the fitted regime expired.

avenues.title: Coast error vs coast time, measured from GEV's own fix history
avenues.status: harness shipped (coast_divergence.py: ports of arcOffsetEnu, estimateTurnRateDps, staleCoastLimitSeconds; fetch/measure/selftest), self-tested on great-circle synthetics with a ~120 m tangent-plane floor at 69 km. UNMEASURED on real fixes: OpenSky and adsb.lol were unreachable from the session. Run `fetch` where they are, then `measure`.

avenues.title: Cross-track distance as a band claim
Traffic simulation must enter the bridge as 'asserted'
Validity scope on the kinematic constants

domains.title: Infrastructure: datacenters, dams, submarine cables, installations on the globe; energy coupling and consent in the bridge
domains.shape: Dams are G->EM nodes, datacenters are EM->T sinks, cables are EM information channels. The coupling matrix has the efficiencies; the globe has the positions; neither has the flows.

avenues.title: Coupling-matrix nodes at geographic positions
Consent gate on any GEV dataset mounted into the atlas
Installation feed as a stale-aware claim

domains.title: Feed integrity: GEV's six feed states and serve-stale caches; the bridge's epistemology grades, drift detector and instrument route
domains.shape: Both repos already refuse to render a dead channel as healthy. They do it in two vocabularies. One table joins them.

avenues.title: One feed-state to epistemology table
Refusal-cached-as-data as a registered principle instance
A null run for the tracking harness
Age distributions instead of a stale boolean

domains.title: Sensing edge: public cameras and radio on the globe; Pi Zero field nodes, LoRa, HAM and CB relay in the bridge
domains.shape: GEV consumes other people's sensors over HTTP. The bridge builds its own and moves their readings over radio. The seam is the .obs line.

avenues.title: A field-nodes layer: .obs lines on the globe
Camera pack schema as a sensor-pack schema
A spoken relay through the voice agent

domains.title: Analyst and agent: spoken queries and voice tools on the globe; residual router, T1-T4 claim tester and null gates in the bridge
domains.shape: GEV answers questions over records and confirms only what happened. The bridge proposes routes with evidence and refuses to conclude. Same posture, opposite directions.

avenues.title: Coverage and feed state on every narrated answer
A spoken claim through T1-T4
A null harness for the HUD summary
The analyst result set as a Reading

domains.title: Detection and attention: bounded cohorts, label quotas, focus and the render governor on the globe; pins, strobe scheduling and drill targets in the bridge
domains.shape: Both repos ration attention: which of 12k objects gets a label, which frame gets a heavy computation. GEV's governor is the better design. The bridge has the null test the quota weights have never had.

avenues.title: Null harness on allocateLayerQuotas layerWeights
avenues.status: MEASURED 2026-09-16, src/data/labelArbiterNull.test.mjs in the fork: random weights in [0.5, 2] reproduce the shipped allocation 18-31% of the time at capacities 16-128 (not the 77% AISS shape), and the shipped weights move ~3% of labels against flat weights (0.45 of 16, 1.84 of 64). Reading: load-bearing and small, a tiebreak on top of sqrt(count). Both halves pinned.

avenues.title: Render governor holds replace the strobe modulo
Priority is a projection and says so
The tracking harness as a worked pin

domains.title: Encoding and wire: share-link tokens and layer-state params on the globe; Gray codes, GEIS tokens, the 32-bit bridge header and the 41-byte claim in the bridge
domains.shape: GEV serialises a view into a URL hash. The bridge serialises a measurement into Gray bands and a claim into 41 bytes. Both have a version field; only one has a checksum.

avenues.title: A view as a Primitive over a voice-only channel
Layer tokens and the modality nibble in one table
GEV feed claims in .claims line format
Share-link round-trip as a lossless-ness test

domains.title: Visualization: Cesium globe, GLSL styles and world overlays; React + Three.js field view, the JS solver mirror and Gaussian splats in the bridge
domains.shape: The bridge has a field solver with a JavaScript mirror that has never been drawn on a globe. GEV has a globe that has never drawn a field.

avenues.title: solver.js as a GEV layer
Trails as 4D splat chains
Octahedral glyphs as overlay tokens
